day_encounters.our_name: Last Call at the Break Room

f01-z08.narrator_line: Zone-close traffic. Hostile units are exiting offline zones into this hall. Clear the corridor.

voice_lines.intro: Zone-close traffic. Hostile units are exiting offline zones into this hall. Clear the corridor.
voice_lines.twist: A shutter slams down between you and the door you came through. The audience gasps, then shrugs. The other door is open.
voice_lines.win: Hall cleared, shutters stopped. The zone behind you is gone for good. Keep moving.
